entry_condition: Study C may reach this stage only after v0.3 permits opening slot C, all frozen external-data/asset/geometry gates pass, and development synthetic qualification passes at alpha=0.025.

panel.role: Study C confirmatory panel only; development genetic response remains permanently closed

allowed_view: Reveal and persist only canonical-valid versus noncanonical/missing aligned-character masks: A/C/G/T -> 1; every other symbol -> 0. Nucleotide identity must not persist.

edge_admissibility.valid_sequence_pair: jointly canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)
edge_admissibility.valid_frozen_edge: at least one valid cross-locality sequence pair exists between unchanged frozen graph endpoints
edge_admissibility.failed_species: drop species; do not rewire, switch marker, delete sequences, relax threshold, or backfill

post_mask_dyad_support.geographic_support: unchanged Study C frozen opportunity contract
post_mask_dyad_support.unsupported_target: drop from confirmatory dyad estimand without replacement
post_mask_dyad_support.adequacy_gate: No post-hoc absolute cluster threshold. Exact survivor-geometry synthetic Type-I/power requalification under the already frozen C qualification rule is binding.

forbidden: inspect Study C nucleotide identity before survivor requalification passes
change the 0.50 comparable-site threshold after mask opening
retain duplicate-header species by changing the parser
replace R_hist, current-environment nuisance, climate variables, time slices, PCA/KDE, controls, alpha, estimator, or effect floor after mask opening
convert gate failure into a biological null
